name: Baïkal
description: Host your own calendars and address books: syncs with iOS, Android, Thunderbird and every CalDAV/CardDAV client.
compose:
services:
  baikal:
    image: ckulka/baikal:nginx
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/var/www/baikal/config
      - ./data:/var/www/baikal/Specific
    restart: unless-stopped
